integrity: The proof derives the exact residual operator, reduces the condition-number-constrained matrix family to one scalar orientation parameter, proves uniqueness of the maximizer by Descartes' rule, and obtains the frontier by exact polynomial elimination. The standalone checker replays the exact rational witness and numerical root isolation; it is corroborative rather than a substitute for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers exact-arithmetic one-sweep classical Gauss-Seidel on real 2x2 SPD systems in a prescribed coordinate order and Euclidean residual norm. It does not optimize the coordinate permutation, cover higher dimensions, randomized or symmetric variants, SOR, asynchronous updates, or finite precision.
title: Sharp residual-monotonicity frontier for a prescribed two-coordinate Gauss–Seidel sweep
